purpose: Teach: 楓/出逢い/隠れ家/どんぐり/硬貨/大砲/散髪/ブルーベリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、楓の紅葉のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your regulars was telling me about the maple leaves turning color.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Gentle opening. Speaking as though sharing something noticed about Aoi's world. Warm but reflective — not intrusive. Slight pause before the detail, like offering a small gift of knowledge.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お客様のお気に入りの方との出逢いを語ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your customers was sharing about meeting someone special — someone important to them.
lines.style: Tender and careful. Speaking with the delicacy of someone who honors what was confided. Quiet conviction that this moment mattered. Open-ended, like leaving room for Aoi to fill in what she already knows.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店、お客様の隠れ家みたいって言われたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your shop — they called it a kind of refuge, a hideaway.
lines.style: Pleased recognition, almost private. Measured pace. A gentle acknowledgment of something Aoi has built without trying too hard. Slight lift at the end, like a small victory being noted.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、どんぐり風のクッキー作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should make acorn-shaped cookies for a new menu item.
lines.style: Animated and forward-leaning. Bright energy, practical enthusiasm. Quick tempo on the suggestion itself, like an idea that feels right arriving suddenly. Inviting Aoi into the planning with genuine excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レジで硬貨で払って下さるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your regulars pays with coins at the register — I noticed that about them.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative. Speaking as though cataloguing small, true details. Gentle observation without judgment. A quiet affection in noticing the specific habits of people Aoi knows.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、博物館で大砲の展示を見られたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned they saw a cannon display at the museum.
lines.style: Calm, conversational sharing. Speaking as though relaying a small detail that crossed her mind. Even pace, genuine interest but not forced. The tone of someone remembering something told to them with care.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、散髪してきたみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your customers got a haircut — they look nice.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the observation. Gentle lift at the end, like a small compliment being passed along. Not effusive, but genuine. The tone of someone who notices when people care for themselves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ブルーベリーマフィン加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's add blueberry muffins to the new menu.
lines.style: Animated, practical enthusiasm. Bright energy matching the acorn cookies suggestion. Quick and assured, like ideas clicking into place. The warmth of building something together with someone you trust.
